verdict.rationale: A system-to-system channel is a fair question for a government online-registration service, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents human-facing access: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, professional certificates for lawyers, notaries and solicitors, and eIDAS, all used through a web form. Nothing describes system accounts, transmitter programs, batch submission or an API enrollment path, so the verdict is none.
